text: I talked to my sister a lot. I avoided travelling alone for a while, then started again with short trips. That helped.

I went back to my previous therapist, who I'd seen for the birth trauma. She was supportive and not judgemental. We did EMDR on both the birth and the retreat. It took about eight months. I also saw a psychiatrist who prescribed an SSRI for the panic attacks, which helped. The retreat organisers offered a follow-up call, but they kept insisting that I'd 'released' something important and should come back for a second retreat, which felt dismissive and made me angry. My husband and I did some couples sessions, which helped him understand. I'm better now but still more anxious than before.
I saw a therapist who specialises in OCD, did ERP. It helped a lot. I'm also on a low dose of fluvoxamine.
Ich bin einfach immer wieder Zug gefahren, am Anfang nur kurze Strecken. Das hat geholfen.

I've seen my GP, a psychiatrist and two therapists. The psychiatrist tried escitalopram, then lamotrigine, then a combination. The lamotrigine helped a little with the intensity of the DP but not much else. The first therapist didn't know much about DP and kept focusing on the breakup, which wasn't the issue. The second therapist knew about DP/DR and focused on reducing my anxiety about it, which helped somewhat.

I've tried meditation but it often makes it worse. Exercise helps briefly. Being with friends helps, though I often feel like I'm acting.

I also, stupidly, tried microdosing mushrooms after reading that it could 'reset' DP. It made it worse for weeks.

Honestly, I'm still struggling. Nothing has really fixed it. I've just gotten a bit better at living with it.

I talked to a counsellor at my university a few times. Mainly I just avoided the news and slowly reintroduced it. Talking to my mum about it helped, and so did volunteering for a refugee charity, which gave the feelings somewhere to go.
Ich habe mit der Leiterin der Zeremonie zwei Integrationsgespräche geführt. Das hat geholfen, die Erfahrung einzuordnen. Ansonsten Zeit.
Sleep hygiene stuff, melatonin, no caffeine. A few sessions of CBT for insomnia which helped a lot. Never doing mescaline again.

I told my parents, who took me to a psychiatrist. He said there was no sign of schizophrenia and explained risk factors. That helped a lot. I saw a therapist for a few months for the anxiety. I don't use any drugs now.
Family therapy for a few sessions, it helped.
